hero.h1: Trenchless Sewer Repair in Hanover Park, IL
hero.sub: Your sewer line probably runs under the front lawn, a driveway or landscaping you've spent years on. Trenchless repair rebuilds the pipe through small openings, so most of that stays as it is. Our office is on Greenbrook Boulevard.

blocks.body: Trenchless sewer repair, also called no-dig sewer repair, fixes a damaged pipe without digging a trench along its full length. Instead of opening up your yard from the house to the street, we work through one or two access points and repair the pipe from the inside or replace it in place. There are two main methods: cured-in-place pipe (CIPP) lining and pipe bursting. Both fix the line underground, so what's above it stays untouched.

blocks.h2: What Happens on a Trenchless Repair Day
blocks.body: A lining job usually starts in the morning with a cleaning and a fresh camera run, so we're working from today's footage. Next, a liner soaked in resin is pulled or pushed into the old pipe and inflated so it presses against the walls. It cures in place, often in a few hours. Then we reopen any side connections from inside the pipe and run the camera one last time so you can see the finished line. Most Hanover Park homeowners have their plumbing back the same day.

blocks.h2: Trenchless Sewer Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Can trenchless repair fix a sagging line?
items.answer: Not usually. A liner follows the old pipe, so a sag stays a sag. That section needs to be dug and reset.

items.q: How long does a liner last?
items.answer: Liners are designed to last for decades.
Sewer work usually needs a village permit. We handle it for our work.

items.q: How long does the job take?
items.answer: Many lining jobs are done in a day.

items.q: Is a lined pipe smaller than the old one?
items.answer: Slightly smaller inside, but the new surface is smooth with no joints, so it usually flows as well or better.

items.q: Can you line just part of the line?
items.answer: Yes. If only one section is damaged, we can line that part and leave the rest.

items.q: How much does trenchless sewer repair cost in Hanover Park?
items.preview: It depends on length, depth and method. You'll approve a flat price first.
items.answer: It depends on how much of the line needs work, the depth, the method and access. You'll approve a flat-rate price before we start.
